items.name: EVLib
items.description: EVLib is a library for the management and the simulation of Electric Vehicle (EV) activities, at a charging station level, within a Smart Grid environment.

items.name: EV-Simulation
items.description: Simulating a Shared Autonomous Electric Vehicle (SAEV) fleet with Charging Stations (CS). Explore multi-agent interactions, test scenarios, and optimize charging strategies in this SimPy-based simulation.

items.name: IEEE_EVCS_VRFB
items.description: This repository contains the required files to conduct the required simulations and obtain the results presented in the paper "Electric Vehicle Charging Station Based on Wind Energy: Evaluation of the Power Profile for Vanadium Redox Flow Batteries Estimation".

items.name: Electrical-Engineering-Project-Modeling-of-an-Electric-Vehicle-Charging-Station-for-Fast-DC-Charging
items.description: Design, Modeling and Simulation of an Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Station for Fast DC Charging ensuring Quality Power Exchange (V2G & G2V)

items.name: mqtt-ev-charging
items.description: Communication of EV vehicles and charging stations via MQTT protocol and MQTT Broker on a map created with Eclipse SUMO, implementation of charging simulation.

items.name: ev_charging_recommendation_sim
items.description: Examine the performance of charging station recommendation systems for EVs using a python simulation.

items.name: EV-Charging-Station-Placement-Simscape
items.description: This repository comprises of workflows which estimate the number of EV charging stations to install in electrical distribution systems modelled with Simscape libraries and estimate total installation cost from simulation results. Leverage Global Optimization Toolbox to optimize the placement of charging stations to minimize the installation cost.
